anchors: Parts are registered to the authored shoulder/elbow/wrist and hip/knee/ankle points. All orientation choices and normalized pivots are in style-c-motion-paint.mjs.
presentations: Guardian, blue and gold, fingerless gloves
Sentinel, purple and gold, silver gloves

production.method: Two original transparent, sixteen-part painted action plates generated from the protected Guardian and Sentinel illustrations. Each cutout was registered and packed. Materials separate skin, suit, trim and armor.
production.forward: Front three-quarter shoulder and straight bracer, forward clenched and open hands, straight greave, planted boot and three-quarter side-kick sole.
production.profile: New side-lit flexed bicep and bracer angle, compact profile fist, splayed profile fingers, turned thigh and greave, toe-off foot and strongly foreshortened sole.
